fieldValues.title: Shared memory is changed by adding and removing entries, under rules the records state
fieldValues.move: A grouping with more than one writer is never replaced wholesale: writers add or remove their own entries, and a whole-membership replace is refused unless the writer shows it read the current list. A group states in a record what its agents may read, add or change, and an agent reads that record before its first write, so rules of engagement come from the records and not from a brief.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Which group owns which meaning, or who is allowed to be a member of a group (decisions for the owner); the remedy gives agents rules to read, not the content of those rules.
fieldValues.falsifier: A shared grouping loses an entry to a wholesale replace with validation green, or an agent changes something its group record says it may not and nothing refuses or flags it.
fieldValues.return_when: When two agents have written to one shared grouping for a week under the rules record and the owner has checked the membership for lost entries.
